name: Gallery: Phong diffuse interreflection in a closed room (maxdepth 3)
description: Closed room with a teal and a terracotta wall, a ceiling light panel, a sculpture on a plinth, a column, a bench and paintings, maxdepth 3 (direct light plus two diffuse bounces). The ceiling and the underside of the sphere are lit only indirectly and the walls bleed colour, so the pixels test indirect light and the meaning of maxdepth.
